title: A system call table
description:
Model how a system call number selects a kernel function.

```
syscall 0 (read) -> handled
syscall 2 (open, "save.dat") -> handle 4
syscall 99 -> STATUS_INVALID_SYSTEM_SERVICE
```
hints: The real numbers change between Windows versions, which is why programs call `ntdll` instead of using them directly.
requirements: A table of function pointers indexed by number.
The "kernel side" checks the number before using it as an index.
Each handler checks its arguments as if they came from an untrusted program.
stretch: Count calls per number, like a system call monitor.
